title: Hugh de Gournay III reconstruction notes

sources.note: Used for the summary that Hugh added twenty-four parishes/villages in the Beauvaisis on the left bank / eastern side of the Epte.
Used for the preserved place-list attributed to the 'Conquêts Hue de Gournay'.
Modern commune locations used as anchor points for approximate reconstruction.

assumptions: Polygon geometries are modern-reference abstractions for reuse and visualization.
The acquisition area is modeled as a compact frontier block rather than a loose honorific region.
The older core is kept conservative around Gournay-en-Bray and adjacent Bray/Epte communes.
